questions.question: In an election, there were three candidates: A, B and C. 10% of the eligible voters did not vote. Out of those who voted, 45% voted for A, 35% voted for B and the remaining 20% voted for C. 30% of the votes polled for A and 20% of the votes polled for B were later deemed invalid, while all the votes polled for C were deemed valid. If A got 882 more valid votes than B did, how many valid votes did C receive?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

45% voted for A, 35% voted for B and the remaining 20% voted for C.

30% of the votes polled for A and 20% of the votes polled for B were later deemed invalid,

A got 882 more valid votes than B 

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Let the total votes be 'x'

882 = (Valid votes of A) - (Valid votes of B)

⇒ 882 = (70% of 45% of 90% of x) - (80% of 35% of 90% of x)

⇒ 882 = (x × 90 × 10 × 5)/1000000 (7 × 9 - 8 × 7)

⇒ 882 = (4500x)/1000000 × (63 - 56)

⇒ 882 = (45x)/10000 × (7)

⇒ x = (882 × 10000)/(7 × 45)

⇒ x = 14 × 2000 = 28000 votes

Now, valid votes did C recieve

Votes of C = 20% of 90% of valid votes

⇒ Votes of C = 20% × 90% × 28000 

⇒ Votes of C = 0.20 × 0.90 × 28000 

⇒ Votes of C = 0.20 × 25200 = 5040 votes

**∴ Valid votes of C is 5040.**

questions.question: If cos 2A = sin 75°, then the smallest positive value of A is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cos 2A = sin 75°

**Concept used:**

Cos θ = Sin (90 - θ)

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Cos 2A = Sin 75° 

⇒ Sin (90°- 2A) = Sin (75°) 

Removing Sin From LHS and RHS 

⇒ 90° - 2A = 75° 

⇒ 2A = 90° - 75° 

⇒ 2A = 15° 

⇒ A = 15/2 = 7.5° 

**∴ The smallest positive value of A is 7.5°.**

questions.question: Find the total surface area of a closed hemisphere whose radius is 3.5 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
questions.solution:

Radius (r) of the hemisphere = 3.5 cm

Total surface area of a closed hemisphere = 3πr² 

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

TSA = 3π(3.5)² 

⇒ TSA = 3 × 22/7 × 12.25

⇒ TSA = 808.5/7 = 115.5 cm² 

**∴ The total surface area of a closed hemisphere is 115.5 cm2.**

questions.question: Which of the following can be a rationalising factor of ( sqrt 2 + sqrt 3 + sqrt 5) ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(√2 + √3 + √5)

**Calculations:**

The expression that is multiplied with an irrational expression to obtain a rational number is called the "rationalising factor".

For rationalization, we need to multiply the given equation by the given options. If we get a real number by multiplying it then we can choose it as the correct option.

(√2 + √3 + √5)(√2 + √3 - √5) √6

⇒ (2 + √6 - √10 + √6 + 3 - √15 + √10 + √15 - 5)√6

⇒ (2√6)√6 = 12

Here, 12 is rational number

**∴ The rationalising factor of (√2 + √3 + √5) is (√2 + √3 - √5)√6. **

questions.question: The volume of a cone of radius 13 cm is 507 π cm³. Find its height.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The volume of a cone = 507 π cm3.

Radius (r) of cone = 13 cm 

**Formula used:**

Volume of cone = 1/3 πr²h

Where, r = radius

h = Height

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Volume of cone = 1/3 × π × (13)² × h

⇒ 507 π = (1/3) × π × 169 × h

⇒ h = (507 × 3)/169

⇒ h = 1521/169 = 9 cm

**∴ The height of the cone is 9 cm.**

questions.question: When f(x) = 15x³ – 14x² – 4x + 10 is divided by (3x + 2), then the remainder is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

By the Remainder Theorem, if a polynomial f(x) is divided by (ax + b), the remainder is f(−b/a).

Here, dividing by (3x + 2) means we substitute x = −2/3 into f(x).

f(−2/3) = 15(−8/27) − 14(4/9) − 4(−2/3) + 10

f(−2/3) = −40/9 − 56/9 + 24/9 + 90/9 = 18/9 = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Polynomial f(x) = 15x³ − 14x² − 4x + 10

Divisor = 3x + 2

**Formula Used:**

Remainder Theorem: If f(x) is divided by ax + b, the remainder is f(−b/a).

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let 3x + 2 = 0

⇒ 3x = −2

⇒ x = −2/3

⇒ Substitute x = −2/3 in f(x) to find the remainder:

⇒ Remainder = 15(−2/3)³ − 14(−2/3)² − 4(−2/3) + 10

⇒ Remainder = 15(−8/27) − 14(4/9) + 8/3 + 10

⇒ Remainder = −40/9 − 56/9 + 24/9 + 90/9

⇒ Remainder = (−40 − 56 + 24 + 90) / 9

⇒ Remainder = 18 / 9

⇒ Remainder = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Remainder Theorem

When a polynomial p(x) is divided by a linear polynomial (x − a), the remainder is equal to p(a).

Factor Theorem

A polynomial p(x) has a factor (x − a) if and only if p(a) = 0. This is a special case of the remainder theorem.

Polynomial Division

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder, where the degree of the Remainder is strictly less than the degree of the Divisor.
</p

questions.question: The average present age of four members of a family is 27 years and average increases by 3 years when one of their relatives joins them. The age of the relative is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average present age of four members of a family is 27 years 

Average increases by 3 years when one of their relatives joins them

**Concept used:**

Average value = (Sum of all the values)/Total no. values)

**Calculations:**

Let the age of relative be 'x'

According to the question,

Average age = [(4 × 27) + x]/5

⇒ 30 = (108 + x)/5

⇒ 108 + x = 150

⇒ x = 150 - 108 = 42 years

**∴ The age of the relative is 42 years. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

Average increases by 3 years when one of their relatives

joins them and common average = 27

Total member = 5 

so, extra age = 5 × 3 = 15

 

new relative age = 27 +15 = 42

questions.question:
In an engineering institution, a student’s grade is assessed based on Internal tests (30%), assignments (30%) and external exams (40%). If a student scored 90% in internal tests, 95% in assignments and 75% in external exams, then the overall

grade of the student is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marks distribution = Internal tests (30%) + Assignments (30%) + External exams (40%) = 100%

Student Scored = 90% of internal test + 95% of Assignments + 75% of external exam

**Concept used:**

Percentage = (Given value/Total value) × 100

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Total percentage (PT) student acquired = 90% of internal test + 95% of Assignments + 75% of external exam

⇒ PT = 90% of 30 + 95% of 30 + 75% of 40

⇒ PT = 90% × 30 + 95% × 30 + 75% × 40

⇒ PT = 0.90 × 30 + 0.95 × 30 + 0.75 × 40

⇒ PT = 27% + 28.5% + 30%

⇒ PT = 85.50%

**∴ The overall grade of the student is 85.50%.**

questions.question: 30 men can complete a piece of work in 24 days. 12 days after they started working together, 10 more men joined them. How many days will they now take to complete then remaining work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The remaining work can be completed by 30 men in (24 − 12) = 12 days.

After 10 more men join, total men working = 30 + 10 = 40.

Applying the M₁ × D₁ = M₂ × D₂ rule for the remaining work:

30 × 12 = 40 × D₂

D₂ = 360 ÷ 40 = 9 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 9 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial number of men = 30

Total time to complete the work = 24 days

Number of days worked initially = 12 days

Number of new men joined = 10

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 30 Men

 720
 30
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the efficiency of 1 man be 1 unit/day.

⇒ Total work = 30 × 24 = 720 units.

⇒ Work done in 12 days by 30 men = 30 × 12 = 360 units.

⇒ Remaining work = 720 − 360 = 360 units.

⇒ Total men working after 12 days = 30 + 10 = 40 men.

⇒ Total efficiency of 40 men = 40 units/day.

⇒ Time required for remaining work = Remaining work ÷ Total efficiency

⇒ Time required = 360 ÷ 40 = 9 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 9 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Chain Rule (MDH Concept)

Used to relate Men (M), Days (D), Hours (H) and Work (W) across two scenarios: (M₁ × D₁ × H₁) ÷ W₁ = (M₂ × D₂ × H₂) ÷ W₂.

Efficiency Concept

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken. If A is twice as efficient as B, then A takes half the time B takes to finish the same piece of work.

Work and Wages

Wages are always distributed in direct proportion to the total work done by each person, or in the ratio of their efficiencies if they work for the exact same number of days.
</p
